hybrid_stack.score_note: Each column is an out-of-fold class-1 probability from the training split. Those four columns are standardized before the blender.

tuning.caveat: The ranking uses the same test split as the headline F1, so that single number is mildly optimistic. The saved predictor is that leader. The hybrid blender is fit only on out-of-fold training scores. Multi-seed means in metrics.json are the uncertainty check.

notes: Primary ranking metric is positive-class F1.
The deployed predictor is a stack: logistic regression blends out-of-fold scores from logistic regression, RBF SVM, gradient boosting, and random forest.
Seed 42 metrics describe the saved models. The other four seeds repeat the full grid search and the stack on their own stratified splits and scalers.
Paper percentages are a reference, not a target. Differences are expected because the data are simulated.
